collection.title: Citroen Dispatch 1995 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen Dispatch 1995 to 2007 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
